sql.processStepAttachmentType.getStepTypes: select psat.id, psat.process_step_id, psat.attachment_type_id, psat.archived, at.attachment_type, psat.display_order from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on psat.attachment_type_id = at.id where psat.process_step_id = :processStepId and psat.archived is not true order by psat.display_order
sql.processStepAttachmentType.getAvailableTy: select at.id, at.attachment_type, at.archived from flow.attachment_type at where at.archived is not true and not exists ( select psat.attachment_type_id from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat where psat.process_step_id = :processStepId and psat.attachment_type_id = at.id and psat.archived is not true ) order by at.attachment_type
sql.processStepAttachmentType.get: select psat.id, psat.process_step_id, psat.attachment_type_id, at.attachment_type, psat.archived from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on psat.attachment_type_id = at.id where psat.id = :id
sql.processStepAttachmentType.addTypeToStep: insert into flow.process_step_attachment_type(process_step_id, attachment_type_id, created_by_id, display_order) values (:processStepId, :attachmentTypeId, :createdById, (select coalesce(max(display_order) + 1, 0) from flow.process_step_attachment_type pse where process_step_id = :processStepId and archived is false))
sql.processStepAttachmentType.updateDisplayO: update flow.process_step_attachment_type set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAttachmentType.deleteTypeFrom: update flow.process_step_attachment_type set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
